Every `upnext serve` command and its help, as `--help` prints it. Each also accepts the [global flags](/commands#global-flags).

## `upnext serve`

```text
DESCRIPTION
  Run the daemon and serve the feed on its socket

USAGE
  upnext serve [flags]

INHERITED FLAGS
  --socket string    Path to the daemon socket (default: $UPNEXT_SOCK, then $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/upnext/upnext.sock)
```
